newsitem.title: TUNISIA: Libya, Iran sign deal for expanding cement factory.
newsitem.headline: Libya, Iran sign deal for expanding cement factory.

text.p: Libya and Iran have signed a deal to add a production line at a Libyan cement factory, Libya's state-run television reported on Wednesday night.
Under the deal the Zliten factory about 100 km (60 miles) east of Tripoli would raise production capacity to 3.2 tonnes per day, it said.
The deal was signed at the factory by Iranian Industry Minister Mohammad Reza Nematzadeh and Libya's Industry and Mining Minister Muftah Azzouz.
The television said the factory was producing for the domestic market but gave no details of what the Iranian role in the expansion might be.
